observable_failure_step.description: Subagent generates <w:jc w:val="right"/> for Persian paragraph alignment, producing physical left alignment.

root_cause_diagnosis: Subagents mapped the English semantic concept of 'right alignment' to the literal XML attribute 'right' (<w:jc w:val="right"/>). However, under ISO/IEC 29500-1 / ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.3.1.13, justification operates logically relative to the paragraph's BiDi direction. In a Right-To-Left (RTL) paragraph (<w:bidi/>), 'right' corresponds to the trailing edge (physical left), whereas 'left' corresponds to the leading edge (physical right). This represents a direct violation of OpenXML logical alignment rules in BiDi contexts.
prescribed_behavior: When generating or modifying OpenXML for BiDi (Persian) text, subagents MUST NOT use <w:jc w:val="right"/> to achieve physical right alignment. They must either omit the w:jc tag (relying on default RTL leading alignment), or explicitly use logical justification attributes such as <w:jc w:val="both"/> for narrative body. The literal attribute w:val="right" is strictly banned in BiDi contexts.
